description: GoGo-BE#709 — Vietnamese intent cases. Deterministic fields (partySize, budget, timeHint, areaText) are asserted by intent.spec.ts on every run; model fields (category, occasion, inScope, needsClarification) are measured only by an authorized live `pnpm eval:intent`. Taxonomy keys are the seed taxonomy (libs/database/src/seed.ts). partySize counts only an explicit number or an explicit pair phrase; knownParserGaps lists fields the parser is known to get wrong — the spec asserts they are still wrong, so fixing one forces updating this file.
